title: GM Draft, Picks, and Scouting Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Draft_GetCurrentSelection (RVA 0x92a6a0) locates draft pick via 0x14092a170 and verifies round/pick/ownership packed in [DraftPick + 0x1c].
claims.falsification_note: Pick protection clauses alter effective ownership if lottery draw lands within protected threshold.

claims.statement: Draft_SelectProspect (RVA 0xec9610) accepts prospect pointer (rcx) and pick context (rdx), assigning rookie rights to the current pick owner.
instructions: 0xec9645: call 0x140eca640 (fetches active draft pick if rdx is null)
claims.falsification_note: A prospect already drafted cannot be selected a second time.

claims.statement: Scout_ExecuteTrip (RVA 0x1261d40) checks remaining trip budget in bits 15..18 of [ScoutContext + 0x1068] and triggers progress generation.
claims.falsification_note: Scouting progression reveals prospect attributes progressively over time; full unlock requires multiple trips.
